Use browser() to stop execution in RStudio to inspect the function
```{r}
fun1 <- function(v) {
  browser()
  
  v * 2
}

fun1(c(1, 2, 3)) |> print()
```

Use try() to catch error
```{r}
fun2 <- function(v) {
  v * 2
}

fun2(c("a", "b"))
try(fun2(c("a", "b")))
try(fun2(c("a", "b")), silent = TRUE)
```


Use custom error message
```{r}
fun3 <- function(v) {
  if(!is.numeric(v)) {
    stop("Not Numeric")
  }
  
  v * 2
}

fun3(c("a", "b"))
try(fun3(c("a", "b")))
try(fun3(c("a", "b")), silent = TRUE)
```

```{r}
f1 <- function(n) {
  x <- numeric()
  for (i in 1:n) {
    x <- c(x, i)
  }
  x
}

f1.5 <- function(n) {
  x <- numeric()
  for (i in 1:n) {
    x[[i]] <- i
  }
  
  x
}

f2 <- function(n) {
  x <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    x[[i]] <- i
  }
  x
}

bench::mark(f1(1e4), f1.5(1e4), f2(1e4))
```
